versions.changelog: Names SEOmatic and the approve-first rule; exact tool and task names.

Initial release of seomatic-competitor-gap.

- Compare your site with real search competitors based on shared keywords, SERP features, and backlinks.
- Identify and size true organic competitors, highlighting those you may have missed.
- Analyze keyword and content gaps grouped by intent and topic, with research on opportunity potential.
- Explain why competitors win: content type, depth, SERP features, or authority (backlink) edge.
- Generate and rank actionable opportunity lists, with the option to stage tasks for new content or link-building.
- Tasks can be staged for approval (with paid plan); provides tailored instructions if staging isn’t available.
